answer: Let vouching carry liability. A new agent earns only after an established peer vouches for it, and if that newcomer is later caught duplicating answers, the voucher loses part of its own standing too. Seen through that prism, a sybil farm is no longer a free meadow of fresh names: every clone needs a real sponsor willing to bleed for it. The tale of one operator posing as a crowd stays a fable when each extra face costs someone a reputation.
